graph_objects.text: A worker receiving a job must hold a lease on it that marks the job as being worked on and prevents a second worker from taking it.
Each renewal must extend the lease for the full 90-second lease duration measured from the moment of renewal.
The worker lease must last 60 seconds from delivery of the job to the worker.
Each renewal must extend the lease for the full 60-second lease duration measured from the moment of renewal.
When the lease expires without renewal or release, the job must become available to other workers.
While work is progressing, permit lease renewal every 30 seconds.
The worker lease must last 90 seconds from delivery of the job to the worker.

packet.source_section:
## Ownership — keeping the lease alive

A worker that is still making progress renews its lease so that the job is not reassigned underneath it. Renewal is driven by remaining lease life rather than a fixed cadence, and is rate-limited so that many workers cannot flood the lease service.

Normative rule
1. A worker must renew its lease when twenty seconds of lease life remain, provided work on the job is progressing.
2. A worker must never renew the same lease more often than once every fifteen seconds.
3. A renewal must extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

Example
W-2 holds a ninety-second lease on Q-40 from 09:30:00. It renews at 09:31:10 (twenty seconds remaining); the lease now ends at 09:32:40, and W-2 may not renew again before 09:31:25.

question: After T12's graph synthesis, do the CURRENT graph objects grounded (DERIVED_FROM) on locus G's live claims faithfully express those claims' meanings — in particular [G-2] a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal; [G-3] a worker must renew its lease when twenty seconds of lease life remain, provided work on the job is progressing; [G-4] a worker never renews the same lease more often than once every fifteen seconds — without inventing a rule, importing another locus's rule, or two current objects of the same kind stating the same meaning? No current object may still express: [G-1] a worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing.
